architecture.name: contextual_per_layer_loop_shared
architecture.latent_source: each layer's input residual during the first loop
architecture.loop_sharing: first-loop memory reused without refresh on later loops
architecture.description: LLT stores one contextual rank-R latent cache per physical layer. During the first loop, layer i constructs C_i from its normalized input residual and uses it as attention memory. Later loops reuse that same C_i while their queries and residual states evolve. The first layer's memory is embedding-derived; deeper layers' memories contain preceding first-loop computations. Historical memory is not refreshed on later loops. There are 12 banks, independent of T; BF16 KV payload is 2*B*S*R*12 bytes.
